A key property of DA is that it is strategy-proof for applicants — truthful reporting of preferences is a dominant strategy regardless of other applicants' preferences or my priority levels at each school.

Even though most other applicants prefer y > x > w > z, and my priorities are mediocre everywhere (3 at w and x, 4 at y and z), misrepresenting my true preferences cannot improve my outcome under DA — it can only hurt me or leave me unmatched inefficiently.
